strings: The leg is too mangled. r_c sighs and prepares the poppy seeds to knock m_c out while it's removed.
When m_c wakes up from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} poppy-induced sleep, r_c breaks the news that m_c's leg had to be removed.

m_c wakes up one leg less than {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} went to sleep with, and it's both upsetting and a relief. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} leg was so mangled, and m_c in so much pain, that this might be for the best. But it's still a loss.
The damage to m_c's leg has turned out to be too great. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} leg had to be removed for any hope of recovery.
m_c has healed from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} mangled leg, but the leg had to be removed completely.
